lead.headline: Tuten misses Wednesday; Likely turns questionable
lead.deck: Golden is in and Walker is out for JuiceJam — but two of your Sunday starters are in doubt.
lead.body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise on Wednesday with the foot and ankle, Adam Schefter reported at 21:13 UTC. Isaiah Likely is now questionable with a groin — limited Wednesday, which Rotoworld reads as a good sign, but no tight end sits behind him. Josh Jacobs is unlikely to play tonight. Now the good: you moved Matthew Golden into the lineup before tonight's game, and Kansas City ruled out Kenneth Walker III, whom JuiceJam had in their lineup. The lineup is the projection lineup. If Tuten sits on Sunday, Jonathan Taylor takes his seat; if Likely sits, add Kyle Pitts Sr., a free agent, and drop Aaron Jones Sr.

doFirst.headline: Two decisions, made in advance
doFirst.deck: Tuten's and Likely's fallbacks, checked Sunday 10:30.
doFirst.note: Golden is in — the morning's swap is done. If Tuten sits, start Taylor; if Likely sits, add Pitts (free agent, no priority) and drop Aaron Jones.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to move this afternoon: Golden is in and the lineup is the projection lineup.

cards.headline: If Likely sits, add Pitts
cards.reason: Likely: groin, limited Wednesday. No tight end on the bench.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup (130.6); Taylor and Gordon tie at 14.0. Tuten and Likely are conditional.

wire.deck: Nothing worth season-long priority. The one newcomer to the screen, Jaydn Ott, passes: Emmett Johnson leads Kansas City with Walker out.
